source_caption_text:
Lil Uzi Vert still had one of the cleanest exits on Kai Cenat’s stream 😭🔥 

Via; @kaicenat 

They were dancing to “20 Min” and Uzi somehow made leaving look like part of the choreography 😂💯

The song was already setting the mood, but the way Uzi kept the energy going right into the exit made the moment. Most people would stop to say goodbye Uzi gave the stream one last highlight on the way out.

“20 Min” is the perfect soundtrack for a moment like this. That instantly recognizable beat comes on and suddenly a regular hangout turns into a whole performance. Add Uzi dancing to their own song with Kai and you get a clip that deserves a few replays.

It’s the timing that makes this one so good. Nothing about the exit interrupts the vibe; it just becomes the ending to the moment. You almost have to watch it again to appreciate how smoothly it all comes together 😭👏

Imagine making the song everyone’s dancing to and then casually using it as your own exit music. Uzi had that one figured out 😂🔥

Who remembers catching this live?
